thread:
support-agent: @ingrid we have Brightline Health (tenant brightline-001) locked out after the RBAC refactor. Customer reports 403 on model list and billing pages.
ingrid: reproducing with org=brightline-001. /v1/models -> 403, /console/billing -> 403. App logs show KMS decrypt failures when validating service tokens.
security-oncall: P0. Did we rotate keys or change bindings overnight? @ryan any deployments touching role mappings or KMS?
ryan: I rolled the role-squash PR #4821 at 03:15 UTC which consolidated legacy roles. Migration job ran, but I saw errors for some external tenants during the run. No intentional KMS rotation though.
miriam: pulled logs for brightline-001, snippet:
```
2025-09-12T03:18:07Z ERROR kms.decrypt: AccessDeniedException keyId=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/primary/cryptoKeys/tenant-rot
2025-09-12T03:18:07Z INFO rbac: denied action=read.billing resource=tenant/brightline-001 user=svc-account:brightline-app
2025-09-12T03:18:08Z WARN auth: token-validation failed reason=kms-decrypt-failed
```
support-agent: customer says they can't access invoices or start model runs. They need immediate access; billing team is blocked.
ingrid: short-term mitigation: grant explicit bindings for models.viewer and billing.read to the tenant service principal while we triage. I'll apply the change via adminctl.
ryan: running `./adminctl grant --org brightline-001 --role=models.viewer,billing.read --actor infra-migration` now.
ryan: done (03:33 UTC). Please confirm the tenant can access services.
support-agent: Brightline confirms at 03:41 UTC: models list returns items, billing page loads. Access restored.
security-oncall: root cause hypothesis: the role mapping migration omitted external-tenant rule that maps legacy service accounts to new role names; tokens previously encrypted under old KMS key meta didn't get re-encrypted after migration, causing decrypt failures and RBAC checks to fail downstream.
security-oncall: followups (action items):
- INFR-2459: backfill role mappings for external tenants and re-run migration for affected orgs (owner: ryan)
- INFR-2460: one-off re-encrypt/reissue script for service tokens for tenants that saw kms-decrypt failures (owner: ryan)
- INFR-2461: add alert when KMS decrypt failure rate > 3% for any tenant for 5m (owner: miriam)
- INFR-2462: add pre-deploy canary for role mapping changes that validates 5 random external tenants (owner: engineering-release)
miriam: saving audit evidence: captured keys, time windows, and adminctl grants. Notifying compliance to include in incident record.
ryan: I created INFR-2459 and INFR-2460 with steps and rollback. ETA for backfill run: 24 hours. Will post status updates in eng-oncall and here.
support-agent: Customer notified and confirmed they are unblocked. We'll keep them in the loop for a permanent fix.
security-oncall: marking incident resolved for now but keeping follow-ups open. Please attach logs and the migration job stdout to the ticket.
support-agent: closing thread after follow-ups created. :white_check_mark:
